title: Pals Rewards Earning on Wellness Plan Fees
content:
Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans fees earn Pals Rewards points at the member's base earn rate multiplied by the plan's points multiplier. The enrollment fee and settlements do not earn points.

| Plan | Points multiplier on plan fees |
|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 1 |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 1 |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 1 |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 1 |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 1 |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 1 |

With a multiplier of 1 under every plan, a plan fee earns exactly what the member's base earn rate gives on that amount.

## Which charges earn

| Charge on the plan | Earns Pals Rewards points |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | Yes, at the base earn rate multiplied by 1 |
| Paid-in-full term charge | Yes, at the base earn rate multiplied by 1 |
| Overdue month paid on reinstatement | Yes, at the base earn rate multiplied by 1, as a plan fee |
| Enrollment fee | No |
| Cancellation settlement | No |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A member whose base earn rate is a hypothetical 1 point per dollar pays a monthly fee of 54.95 and, earlier, an enrollment fee of 59.95. The monthly fee earns on 54.95 at that base rate multiplied by 1; the enrollment fee earns nothing.
